customer_name: Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office (CDAO), U.S. Department of War
business_problem: The Department of War had hundreds of disconnected AI pilots and needed secure, enterprise-scale access to data and AI tools for personnel across a large organization and multiple defense networks.
solution_summary: Google Public Sector and CDAO launched GenAI.mil, a secure enterprise platform on Google Cloud, in 54 days. Google Kubernetes Engine supports the platform across global networks under defense security guardrails, while Gemini gives military and civilian personnel access to models and tools for building, deploying, and governing custom agents. Gemini 3.6 Flash was deployed inside the platform on its commercial release day. One team used a custom Gemini agent to review a backlog of 27,000 policy documents, reducing work estimated at 11 years to a few weeks. The source names Cloud Storage among products used but does not explain its deployment role or describe document ingestion, indexing, or persistence details.

evidence_quotes: “Google Public Sector, in partnership with the Office of the Under Secretary of War for Research and Engineering, helped the Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office (CDAO) build and launch GenAI.mil in 54 days.”
“Personnel across the department have created over 100,000 custom AI agents tailored to support specific administrative, operational, and research workflows.”
